annotations.title: Monitor ATS Jobs, Hiring Intent & 70+ Tech-Stack Signals

description: Monitor live ATS job openings, 45-120d hard-to-fill aging, and 70+ tech-stack buying signals across 13 ATS engines and 7 global feeds via a 71,900+ board directory and 64-shard live discovery router. Supply targets, presetPacks, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId, OR leave targets empty with titleKeywords/techStackFilter to auto-trigger global live discovery and Reverse-Pivot; omitting both targets and filters returns 0 items at $0. Bills $0.99/1K saved rows ($0 filtered or unchanged), runs ~5-30s isolating per-board failures in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and persists optional watch_diff KV snapshots or webhookUrl alerts (explaining readOnlyHint=false). Use for recruiting signals, tech-stack buying intent, or weekly job-board delta tracking; do not use for editing your own ATS or corporate domain/LinkedIn enrichment without job signals (use enrich_b2b_company_leads instead).

agencyPersona.description: Tailors intentScore weighting and deterministic outreach openers ($0 LLM cost).

crmExportPreset.description: Optional flat CRM column mapping preset.

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID or URL containing target company domains.

dedupMode.description: watch_diff emits 7 time-series triggers & skips unchanged at $0; skip_seen skips all previously seen IDs at $0.

dedupStoreName.description: Optional Named Apify Key-Value Store for 16-shard watch_diff or skip_seen tracking.

keywordScope.description: Match titleKeywords in title only or title + full decoded description.

maxJobsPerCompany.description: Maximum matching jobs emitted per company board (1-500).

maxTotalJobs.description: Hard global cap on total billed rows returned (1-10,000).

onlyHardToFillSweetSpot.description: When true, keep only roles aged 45-120 days ($0 skip otherwise).

onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: 1-click weekly delta mode: skips unchanged seen roles at $0 and emits 7 time-series triggers.

outputMode.description: Emit individual job rows, 1 aggregated hiring-intent dossier per company, or both.

presetPacks.description: Optional curated live-verified vertical ATS board bundles.

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV/TSV rows or newline-separated company domains/ATS URLs.

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId.

targets.description: Company domains, names, or direct ATS URLs (e.g. ["linear.app", "ramp.com", "nvidia.eightfold.ai"]). Leave empty [] with titleKeywords/techStackFilter for Auto-Global 64-shard + 7-feed discovery.

techStackFilter.description: Optional tech-stack tags to require (e.g. ["Rust", "Kubernetes", "Snowflake", "PyTorch"]). Filtered roles are skipped at $0.

titleKeywords.description: Optional job keywords (e.g. ["Snowflake", "Account Executive"]). Activates Auto-Global live search when targets is empty.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTP/HTTPS webhook URL notified on completion.

name: monitor_ats_hiring_intent

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Live ATS jobs or aggregated company hiring-intent dossiers with tech-stack tags, aging tiers, watch triggers, and outreach copy.

atsPlatform.description: Source ATS engine or global feed (greenhouse, ashby, lever, eightfold, smartrecruiters, personio, himalayas, etc.).

daysOpen.description: Verified days open since initial posting (null if unavailable).

hardToFillTier.description: Honest aging bucket: FRESH_0_14D, ACTIVE_15_44D, STUCK_SWEET_SPOT_45_120D, EVERGREEN_120D_PLUS, or UNKNOWN.

jobUrl.description: Direct official ATS or source posting URL.

outreachOpener.description: Deterministic persona-ready opening sentence ($0 LLM cost).

outreachSubject.description: Deterministic persona-ready outreach subject ($0 LLM cost).

salaryDisplay.description: Formatted disclosed salary range if present.

techStackCsv.description: Comma-separated verified tech-stack tags (zero-FP context anchored).

title.description: Job title (or top role headline for company dossiers).

watchTriggers.description: Detected time-series triggers in watch_diff mode.
